name: NetShield Firewall Analyzer
shortInfo: Automated network traffic analysis and threat detection tool
description:
Problem: Manual traffic inspection is too slow for real-time threat response.

Approach: Built a Python-based capture engine integrating Suricata IDS rules with zero-copy packet sniffing for high throughput.

Result: Automated real-time alerts reducing mean-time-to-detect (MTTD) significantly.

name: VaultCrypt Password Manager
shortInfo: Zero-knowledge encrypted password vault with CLI interface
description:
Problem: Existing password managers rely heavily on third-party cloud trust.

Approach: Engineered a local-first vault using AES-256-GCM and Argon2 derivation, entirely accessible via CLI.

Result: A verifiable zero-knowledge system where plaintext keys never leave local memory.

name: WebRecon OSINT Framework
shortInfo: Open-source intelligence gathering toolkit for web targets
description:
Problem: OSINT gathering requires jumping between disparate tools and APIs.

Approach: Aggregated subdomain enumeration, email harvesting, and tech fingerprinting into a single asynchronous Python pipeline.

Result: Comprehensive PDF recon reports generated 5x faster.
